# Save My Exams

> > Comprehensive GCSE exam preparation platform offering revision notes, past papers, mark schemes, and practice questions across multiple exam boards.

Save My Exams provides structured revision resources for UK GCSE students, covering core sciences and other subjects with content tailored to major exam boards including AQA, Edexcel (Pearson), and WJEC. The platform combines expert-written notes, authentic past papers, and interactive study tools to support exam preparation.

## Key Topics

- GCSE
- Past Papers
- Revision Notes
- Mark Schemes
- Exam Boards (AQA, Edexcel, WJEC)
- Chemistry
- Biology
- Physics
- Exam Preparation
- Mock Exams
- Flashcards
- Foundation & Higher Tier
- 2016 Specification
- Study Guides
- Exam Practice

## GCSE Core Subjects

- [GCSE Revision Notes, Past Papers & Exam Questions](https://www.savemyexams.com/gcse): Main GCSE hub with revision notes, past papers, and exam questions
- [GCSE Biology Revision](https://www.savemyexams.com/gcse/biology): GCSE Biology revision resources including notes, questions, and flashcards
- [GCSE Chemistry Revision](https://www.savemyexams.com/gcse/chemistry): GCSE Chemistry revision resources including notes, questions, flashcards
- [GCSE Physics Revision](https://www.savemyexams.com/gcse/physics): GCSE Physics revision resources including notes, questions, flashcards

## AQA GCSE Revision Resources

- [AQA GCSE Biology 2016 Revision](https://www.savemyexams.com/gcse/biology/aqa/18): AQA GCSE Biology revision notes and practice questions by expert teachers
- [AQA GCSE Biology Past Papers [PDFs & Mark Schemes]](https://www.savemyexams.com/gcse/biology/aqa/past-papers): AQA GCSE Biology past papers with mark schemes organized by year
- [AQA GCSE Chemistry 2016 Revision](https://www.savemyexams.com/gcse/chemistry/aqa/18): AQA GCSE Chemistry revision notes and practice questions
- [AQA GCSE Chemistry Past Papers [PDFs & Mark Schemes]](https://www.savemyexams.com/gcse/chemistry/aqa/past-papers): AQA GCSE Chemistry past papers with mark schemes organized by year

- [AQA GCSE Physics Past Papers [PDFs & Mark Schemes]](https://www.savemyexams.com/gcse/physics/aqa/past-papers): AQA GCSE Physics past papers with mark schemes organized by year
